aiHeadlines: 📊 Bayer Leverkusen top the Bundesliga on 9 points after 3 rounds.
⏰ Deadline day is done. The window is shut until January.
⏳ Deadline week. Any business left undone stays undone until the next window.
Borussia Dortmund sign Harry Kane from Bayern Munich for £43m.
Manchester City sign Declan Rice from Arsenal for £123m.
RB Leipzig sign Anthony Gordon from Barcelona for £57m.
Bayern Munich sign Arda Güler from Real Madrid for £83m.
Liverpool sign Cole Palmer from Chelsea for £102m.

boardObjectives.label: Blood 2 under-21 players in the league
Sign someone 21 or under rated 85 or better
Have 13 players from Germany in the squad

inbox.text: Dennis Seimen left a bottle of very expensive wine on your desk. No note, no explanation, message received.
One of your defenders claims a fortune teller told him he will score a hat-trick this weekend, and he has already ordered the match ball display case.

pending.text: Bayern Munich on paper are a level above you. Realistically, what are you going there for?

options.label: Nobody gives us a prayer, and that suits us
options.line: Underdogs and happy about it. Exactly the week your squad needed.

options.label: We are going to win it
options.line: A big call in front of a big audience. They have seen it too.

options.label: We will do our jobs and see
options.line: Dull, safe and forgotten by Friday teatime. The board like a man who promises nothing.

decisions.text: Jamie Leweling was shown a straight red against Porto and is banned for 2 matches. The club secretary rates an appeal at 40 percent. Win and the ban is wiped. Lose and the panel makes it 3 matches. It has to go in before the next match.

options.label: Appeal (40% to wipe the ban, or it becomes 3 matches)
Accept the ban (2 matches, nothing changes)

decisions.text: The squad's fines kitty has £100k in it from late arrivals and phones in meetings. The head coach asks where it should go. The local paper always runs it when it goes to charity.

options.label: Give it to the club's community partner (press mood +2)
Put it in the transfer pot (£100k into the transfer budget)
Leave it in the kitty (nothing changes)

decisions.text: Bilal El Khannouss was shown a straight red against Bayern Munich and is banned for 2 matches. The club secretary rates an appeal at 40 percent. Win and the ban is wiped. Lose and the panel makes it 3 matches. It has to go in before the next match.
decisions.resolved: No appeal went in before the next match, so the 2 matches ban stood.
